message.content:
A vertical rectangular illustration, styled like a magazine cover, features a textured gray background with a red vertical band on the left. The top displays the black text "TRANSFER JANGGAL DIRJEN BEA-CUKAI" and "SEMRAWUT GORONG-GORONG JAKARTA" above the large black title "TEMPO" and the date "27 JANUARI-2 FEBRUARI 2014."

Centrally, a larger-than-life figure in a dark red and white robe with wide sleeves stands with arms outstretched. A wooden gavel floats mid-air to the left. This central figure’s body is depicted as a series of three nested men. The uppermost man has gray hair and glasses. Emerging from his torso is the head and shoulders of another man in a dark suit. Below that second man, a third man in a light-colored suit and trousers appears to step forward from the lower robes. This third figure has a slightly hunched posture and wears glasses. 

Lower-left text in bold black reads "TIGA MERAUP SUAP," followed by smaller text: "Bendahara dan Sekretaris Jenderal Partai Golkar ditengarai terlibat skandal Akil Mochtar." The bottom left features a barcode and price "RP 33.000."
